title: Low Appraisal Guide — Companion Post
message:
A low appraisal doesn't always mean your deal is dead.

One of the biggest misconceptions in real estate is that a home must sell for whatever the appraisal says. While the appraisal is an important part of the financing process, buyers and sellers often have more options than they realize.

I've put together a guide explaining:

• Why appraisals come in low
• What a Reconsideration of Value (ROV) is
• How buyers and sellers can work through appraisal challenges
• Why some deals still close successfully despite a low appraisal

If you're buying or selling a home, understanding this process can save you a lot of stress.

Read the full article here:
https://calvinlymanrealestate.com/resources/guides/why-low-appraisal-doesnt-kill-home-purchase
